Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL ID and target type SINGLE PROTEIN. Join activities to compound_records and molecule_dictionary to obtain molecule ChEMBL IDs. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pchembl_value.
